title: How and when to use artificial intelligence in your science job application
excerpt: A webinar offers advice to hiring managers and jobseekers.
content_html:
• CAREER NEWS
  • 10 August 2026

A webinar offers advice to hiring managers and jobseekers.

By

  • David Payne0
  1. David Payne

    1. David Payne is chief careers editor at Nature.

A free webinar on how to use artificial intelligence in science job applications is now available to view on demand.

The live event, hosted by Nature’s Careers team in June, investigates AI’s growing role in science recruitment, and how jobseekers can use it responsibly and effectively to draft CVs, cover letters and interview questions.

The hour-long recording also covers how researchers can get their applications noticed by recruiters, who are increasingly using AI tools to shortlist candidates.

Host Julie Gould is joined by Richard Stevenson, a director at life-sciences recruitment consultancy Barrington James in Billericay, UK, and Fernando Spilki, a veterinary virologist at Feevale University in Novo Hamburgo, Brazil.

doi: https://doi.org/10.1038/d41586-026-02435-2

网络研讨会为招聘经理和求职者提供建议。

By

  • 大卫·佩恩0
  1. 大卫·佩恩 (David Payne) 大卫·佩恩 (David Payne) 是《自然》杂志的首席职业编辑。

关于如何在科学工作申请中使用人工智能的免费网络研讨会现已可供按需观看。

这项现场活动由 Nature’s Careers 团队于 6 月主办，调查了人工智能在科学招聘中日益重要的作用，以及求职者如何负责任且有效地使用它来起草简历、求职信和面试问题。

长达一小时的录音还涵盖了研究人员如何让招聘人员注意到他们的申请，招聘人员越来越多地使用人工智能工具来筛选候选人。

主持人朱莉·古尔德 (Julie Gould) 与英国比勒里凯 (Billericay) 生命科学招聘咨询公司 Barrington James 的主管理查德·史蒂文森 (Richard Stevenson) 以及巴西新汉堡菲瓦勒大学 (Feevale University) 的兽医病毒学家费尔南多·斯皮尔基 (Fernando Spilki) 一起参与了节目。

doi：https://doi.org/10.1038/d41586-026-02435-2
